What is the problem?

Some teams do not always respond to requests as quickly as expected, which can
cause frustration and delays. Different teams also have different priorities,
and communication can sometimes be challenging.

Who are the users, and how many are affected?

Potentially everyone in the department could be affected at some point. The
exact number is unknown.

What are the benefits of solving this for the department and end users?

It would improve communication, help people work better together and create a
more positive working environment.

How have you tried to solve the problem so far?

We have discussed the issue in meetings and encouraged teams to collaborate more
effectively. Some guidance has been shared, but the problem still occurs.
